event.name: Demo Technology Conference 2026
event.venue: Bengaluru International Tech Convention Centre (BITCC), Whitefield, Bengaluru
event.description: Demonstration event data — A two-day technology summit featuring keynotes, hands-on technical workshops, and architectural tracks across AI, Cybersecurity, Cloud Systems, and Robotics.

sessions.title: Registration, Badge Pickup & Welcome Coffee
sessions.description: Check in with your QR code and government-issued photo ID to collect your smart conference badge, lanyard, and welcome kit.

sessions.title: Opening Keynote: Grounded Foundation Models & Reliable Enterprise AI
sessions.description: Opening keynote exploring how open-weight Gemma architectures and retrieval-augmented verification eliminate hallucinations in mission-critical deployments.

sessions.title: Hands-On AI Workshop: Building Retrieval-Augmented Agents with Gemma
sessions.description: Practical coding workshop covering context retrieval, prompt-injection defense, structured output schemas, and low-latency inference with Google Gemma models. Bring a laptop with Python 3.11+ installed.

sessions.title: Zero-Trust Cloud Defense & AI Threat Detection
sessions.description: Deep dive into securing distributed microservices, preventing identity token replay, and hardening enterprise endpoints against automated intrusion.

sessions.title: Networking Lunch & Exhibition Showcase
sessions.description: Complimentary buffet lunch included for all registered badge holders, with vegetarian, vegan, Jain, and gluten-free stations.

sessions.title: Multi-Region Kubernetes & High-Throughput Inference Scaling
sessions.description: Architectural patterns for autoscaling GPU workloads across multiple availability zones while keeping tail latency under 150ms.

sessions.title: Securing LLM Applications Against Prompt Injection & Data Exfiltration
sessions.description: Red-teaming conversational AI interfaces, enforcing strict source-of-truth boundaries, and sanitizing untrusted context payloads.

sessions.title: Day 2 Keynote: Embodied Intelligence & Autonomous Warehouse Robotics
sessions.description: How vision-language-action models enable safe, real-time spatial navigation for industrial collaborative robots.

sessions.title: Post-Quantum Cryptography Readiness for Financial Systems
sessions.description: Migrating TLS pipelines and key-exchange protocols to NIST-standardized lattice-based cryptographic algorithms.

sessions.title: Edge AI Optimization Workshop: Quantization & On-Device Deployment
sessions.description: Hands-on tutorial on 4-bit AWQ quantization and running compact Gemma models on mobile and embedded NPU hardware.

sessions.title: Closing Panel & Certificate Distribution Briefing
sessions.description: Synthesis of conference takeaways, open Q&A with track chairs, and instructions for downloading verified digital attendance certificates.

speakers.name: Dr. Ananya Sharma
speakers.title: Chief AI Scientist, BharatFoundry Labs (Keynote Speaker)
speakers.biography: Dr. Ananya Sharma leads applied foundation model research with 14 years of experience in retrieval-augmented generation, model alignment, and enterprise AI reliability.

speakers.name: Vikram Mehta
speakers.title: Principal Cybersecurity Architect, KavachSec
speakers.biography: Vikram Mehta specializes in zero-trust cloud security, adversarial red-teaming of LLM applications, and critical infrastructure defense across APAC financial institutions.

speakers.name: Priya Nair
speakers.title: VP of Cloud Infrastructure, StratosScale
speakers.biography: Priya Nair oversees multi-region distributed Kubernetes clusters serving over 40 million daily requests and leads open-source GPU scheduling initiatives.

speakers.name: Dr. Rohan Deshmukh
speakers.title: Director of Autonomous Systems, MechaDynamics Institute
speakers.biography: Dr. Rohan Deshmukh researches embodied robotics, spatial SLAM navigation, and real-time control loops for warehouse and medical automation.

speakers.name: Meera Krishnan
speakers.title: Head of Applied Cryptography, FinShield Systems
speakers.biography: Meera Krishnan advises banking regulators and enterprise security teams on post-quantum cryptographic migration and hardware security modules.

speakers.name: Arjun Verma
speakers.title: Staff Edge ML Engineer, NeuralEdge
speakers.biography: Arjun Verma builds compiler toolchains and quantization pipelines for deploying compact language models on consumer laptops and edge NPUs.

venues.name: Main Concourse Registration Desk
venues.directions: Enter directly through Gate 1 at the North Plaza drop-off zone. The registration counters are 20 meters straight ahead beneath the digital welcome arch.
venues.accessibility: Step-free level entrance, tactile floor guidance strips, lowered wheelchair check-in counter at Counter 1, and sign-language interpretation on request.

venues.name: Grand Ballroom A
venues.directions: From the Main Concourse Registration Desk, take the central escalators or Panoramic Elevators E1/E2 up one level to Level 1 and follow signage for Plenary Hall A.
venues.accessibility: Wheelchair seating bays in rows A, F, and M; hearing loop system enabled; live English closed captioning displayed on side LED screens.

venues.name: AI Innovation Lab 204
venues.directions: Take the East Wing elevators (E3/E4) to Level 2, turn right past the tech helpdesk, and walk 35 meters down the glass corridor to Room 204.
venues.accessibility: Wide automatic sliding doors, height-adjustable workstation desks in the front two rows, and accessible restroom directly opposite Room 202.

venues.name: Cyber Defense Auditorium B
venues.directions: From Level 1 Central Atrium, walk west across the skybridge toward the West Wing. Auditorium B-104 is the first large entrance on the left.
venues.accessibility: Ramp access along both aisles, companion seating, and assistive listening receivers available at the auditorium entrance desk.

venues.name: Cloud Workshop Studio 302
venues.directions: Take East Wing elevators (E3/E4) to Level 3 and turn left. Studio 302 is adjacent to the developer lounge.
venues.accessibility: Step-free access via Elevators E3/E4, power outlets at every seat, and wheelchair-accessible seating pods.

venues.name: Main Dining Atrium
venues.directions: Walk south past the Central Concourse coffee bar toward the glass courtyard doors leading into the South Garden Pavilion.
venues.accessibility: Full ground-level access, wide buffet lanes, clearly labeled allergen cards, and low-height dining tables.

faqs.question: Where can I find the registration desk and how do I check in?
faqs.answer: The Main Concourse Registration Desk is located in Tower A (North Entrance), Ground Floor (Level 0), Foyer Counters 1–8. Enter via Gate 1. Present your confirmation QR code (digital or printed) along with a valid government-issued photo ID to receive your conference badge.

faqs.question: What documents and items are required for entry into the venue?
faqs.answer: All attendees must wear their official conference badge visibly at all times and carry a valid government-issued photo ID (Passport, Aadhaar, Driver's License, or PAN card) matching their registration name. Security bag screening is conducted at Gate 1 and Gate 2.

faqs.question: What time does the event start and end each day?
faqs.answer: The conference runs on November 14 and November 15, 2026 (Asia/Kolkata timezone). Doors and registration open at 08:30 IST daily. Opening keynotes begin at 09:30 IST, and formal programming concludes by 18:00 IST on Day 1 and 17:30 IST on Day 2.

faqs.question: Is lunch included with my registration, and are dietary options available?
faqs.answer: Yes, complimentary buffet lunch as well as morning and afternoon coffee/tea refreshments are included for all registered attendees. Lunch is served from 13:00 to 14:15 IST in the Main Dining Atrium (Ground Floor, South Garden Pavilion) with dedicated vegetarian, vegan, Jain, and gluten-free stations.

faqs.question: What should I bring to the event and technical workshops?
faqs.answer: Please bring: (1) Your registration QR code and government photo ID, (2) A fully charged laptop and charger if attending hands-on workshops in AI Innovation Lab 204 or Cloud Workshop Studio 302, (3) Python 3.11+ and Docker pre-installed for the AI workshop, and (4) A refillable water bottle for the hydration stations.

faqs.question: How do I receive a certificate of participation?
faqs.answer: Verified digital certificates of attendance are issued to all attendees who check in at the registration desk. Workshop completion certificates require badge scan check-in at the workshop room entrance. Download links are emailed within 48 hours after Day 2 concludes.

faqs.question: How do I connect to conference Wi-Fi or get on-site technical support?
faqs.answer: Connect to the 'BITCC-Conference-5G' Wi-Fi network using the access code printed on the back of your attendee badge. For workshop environment setup or badge issues, visit the Tech Support Desk on Level 2 outside AI Innovation Lab 204 or email support@demotechconf.example.org.

faqs.question: How can I contact the event organizers or emergency desk?
faqs.answer: You can contact the Event Organizing Committee via email at helpdesk@demotechconf.example.org, by phone at +91-80-4090-2026 (08:00–19:00 IST), or in person at Counter 8 of the Main Concourse Registration Desk (Ground Floor, Tower A).
